title: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Larger PDF uploads**: You can now upload PDFs with up to 100 pages to Genie One and Genie Agents, increased from 20. See [Upload a file](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#upload-a-file) and [Upload a file to a Genie Agent](/aws/en/genie-agents/file-upload).
* **Summarize up to six months of activity**: Authors can now summarize up to six months of Genie Agent activity from the **Monitor** tab. See [Review usage and trends](/aws/en/genie-agents/monitor#usage-trends).
* **Agents use only attached sources**: A Genie Agent now uses only the data assets explicitly attached as sources. See  [Manage data objects](/aws/en/genie-agents/set-up#manage-data).
* **Fixed Analyze Agent Usage summary**: Fixed a bug where Analyze Agent Usage summarized only the last 20 messages sent to the agent.
